hints.text: A composition is worked from the inside out. Which function is sitting inside the parentheses here?
Start with the inside function: $g(2) = 3 \times 2 = 6$. Then feed that $6$ into $f$, which adds $4$.

explanation: A composition runs from the inside out, so $g$ acts on $2$ before $f$ does anything.
The inside function triples its input, so $g(2) = 3 \times 2 = 6$.
The outside function adds $4$ to that result, so $f(6) = 6 + 4 = 10$ and $f(g(2)) = 10$.

alternativeExplanations.title: As two machines in a row
steps: Machine g triples what you feed it: 2 goes in, 6 comes out.
That 6 drops straight into machine f, which adds 4 — giving 10.
